'''''Tanquilla Beach''''' was a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was situated within a [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] on the edge of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and was one day's travel from [[Shintel]]. It gained its name because of the vast amount of light the station received from all directions from the nebulae.

==History==
''Tanquilla Beach'' began life as an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] station located in a major [[Star system/Legends|system]] near [[Gandle Ott]]. When the asteroid field was played out, the station was abandoned. Somehow, outlaw techs managed to move the station to the [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] around [[92 BBY/Legends|92 BBY]]. Over the years, the techs set ''Tanquilla Beach'' up as the perfect place for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Specializing in high technology, the techs filled the empty caverns with buildings and living quarters to support the businesses and personnel that made the ''Beach'' a viable community. The face of the asteroid was covered in metal and plastic, in some places reaching as far as ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the original surface of the asteroid.

After the ''[[FarStar]]'' was damaged by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus at [[Shintel]], it managed to limp to the ''Beach'' for repairs. Enlisting [[Fia (engineer)|Fia]] from [[Spang's]] Repair Shop, the engines were repaired in two weeks. However, while the ''FarStar'' was at the station, Sarne sent one of his [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] to engage it in a hit and fade assault. Unfortunately for Sarne, he didn't know the extent of the ''Beach''{{'s}} armaments. Between the station and the ''FarStar'', the light cruiser was destroyed.

==Layout==
===Commerce===
''Tanquilla Beach'' had fifteen levels of trading space. Bazaars and stores sold a multitude of goods, ranging from [[Droid/Legends|droids]], illegal [[Starship/Legends|ship]] parts and weapons, food, clothing, and other items. Bars and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] halls were in good supply, and [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], technicians and cyberdocs sold their services. Level Twelve was the [[Slavery/Legends|Slaver's]] Market (aka the "meat market"), and many [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] avoided it. Although the majority of slaves were [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were occasionally bought and sold.

===Docking and customs===
Dozens of [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] lined the length of the ''Beach'', ranging in size from small berths for private [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]], up to large hangars to handle multiple smuggling craft. The ''Beach'' had no hangar large enough for ships the size of a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], so larger craft were required to anchor off the station and personnel were shuttled aboard in smaller craft. Security and customs at the ''Beach'' were tight and rigidly enforced. In general, they didn't care what a spacer brought onto the station, as long as they knew about it. Personal weapons were allowed on the station, but heavier weapons like grenades and repeating blasters were prohibited. Docking fees ranged from one hundred to one thousand credits depending upon the size of the vessel.

===The Lock===
The Lock was a section of the ''Beach'' located at the bottom of the station used to store anything that could potentially be lethal to the station. Sealed off from the rest of the station, the Lock could only be accessed via exterior airlocks.

===Defenses===
Defensively, ''Tanquilla Beach'' packed quite a punch. Eighty [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and twenty [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] dotted the surface of the station, most of them procured from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipyards. Five [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and eight [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s assisted in the defense of the station, and ''Tanquilla Beach'' could engage and defeat any ship smaller than a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].
